Comvi i18n 0.5.1 changes how the in-context editor reaches a page: the Comvi browser extension no longer carries it, and `devtools()` loads it when the extension asks. The release also formats `#` in plurals for the locale and fixes the editor. Twelve packages ship at one version.

## Before you upgrade

- **Next.js: add `.use(devtools())`.** `createNextI18n` no longer attaches browser-extension discovery, so without the call the extension does not see the app.
- **A site with a Content Security Policy: allow `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net` in `script-src`** if translators use the extension on it. `style-src` needs no change in current browsers.
- **`#` in a plural prints a formatted number.** Write `{count}` where you want the raw digits.
- **Upgrade the site before the extension.** Extension 0.5.1 edits only a site on `@comvi/core` 0.5.1 or newer with `devtools()`; the 0.5.0 extension keeps working with a 0.5.1 site.

## `devtools()` loads the in-context editor

- **What it does.** `.use(devtools())` still publishes the i18n instance for the Comvi browser extension. It now also installs the loader the extension calls. When a translator presses **Enable editor**, the loader adds one `<script>` for `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@comvi/plugin-in-context-editor@latest/dist/standalone.iife.js`. Nothing is requested before that click, and nothing for a visitor without the extension.
- **Pin the editor** with `devtools({ editorVersion: "0.5.1" })`. It takes an exact version; any other value loads `latest` and warns in development. On `latest` the URL carries a query that changes every hour, which keeps a browser's own copy at most an hour old. The CDN is a separate cache: unless the purge the release requests goes through, jsDelivr's edge can serve the previous `latest` for 12 hours after a release by the cache header it sends today, and jsDelivr documents up to 7 days for a version alias.
- **Size.** `devtools()` costs about 1.2 kB min+gzip over the base i18n instance: `@comvi/core` alone measures 5,451 bytes, and 6,672 with `.use(devtools())` (`core-base` and `core-base-devtools` in `scripts/size-budgets.json`). About 0.7 kB of that is the editor loader, new in 0.5.1; the rest is the discovery `devtools()` already did in 0.5.0. An app on the ESM packages that does not call `devtools()` carries none of it; the `<script>` global build composes it on its own, see Behaviour changes.
- **Content Security Policy.** Add `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net` to `script-src`. If the site enforces Trusted Types, its `default` policy must return that script URL from `createScriptURL`. `style-src` needs no change in current browsers, because the editor adopts a constructable stylesheet.
- **An app that bundles the standalone editor itself** is activated as it is, and nothing is loaded.

## Behaviour changes

- **`@comvi/next`: `createNextI18n` no longer composes discovery.** Until 0.5.1 it published every Next app on `window.__COMVI__` and gave it an `instanceId`. Now the app is not visible to the extension, and `i18n.instanceId` is `undefined`, until you compose discovery as in every other binding:

  ```diff
  -import { createNextI18n } from "@comvi/next";
  +import { createNextI18n, devtools } from "@comvi/next";

  -export const { i18n, routing } = createNextI18n({ ...routing });
  +export const { i18n, routing } = createNextI18n({ ...routing }).use(devtools());
  ```

  `devtools` is also exported from `@comvi/next/client` and `@comvi/next/server`. On the server it publishes nothing. `instanceId` and `exposeGlobal` go to the installer: `devtools({ instanceId: "app" })`.

- **`#` in `plural` and `selectordinal` is formatted for the message's locale**, as ICU MessageFormat defines it. `{count, plural, other {# items}}` renders `1,234 items` in `en` and `1.234 items` in `de`; 0.5.0 inserted the raw digits. `#` follows the `Intl.NumberFormat` defaults, so a fractional count is rounded to three fraction digits (`1.23456` renders `1.235`). Exact selectors (`=0`, `=1`) still compare the number itself, and `{count}` is unchanged.
- **The `<script>` global build of `@comvi/core` gains the editor loader with no code change.** `ComviCore.I18n` and `ComviCore.createI18n` (`dist/comvi-core.global.prod.js`, the file unpkg and jsDelivr serve for the bare package name) compose discovery themselves, so from 0.5.1 they install the loader as well, always on `latest`: the global takes no `editorVersion`. Nothing is requested until a translator with the extension presses **Enable editor**. The loader adds about 0.7 kB min+gzip to that composition (`core-full-composite` went from 9,608 to 10,332 bytes, `scripts/size-budgets.md`). To leave it out, pass `exposeGlobal: false`, which also hides the instance from the extension, or move to the ESM packages and compose what you need. The ESM entries are not affected: `createI18n` from `@comvi/core` and from every binding builds the base i18n instance, which gets the loader only through `.use(devtools())`. One more place composes discovery for you: `inContextEditor()` in a development build, which therefore installs the loader too; its production entry does nothing.
- **A function passed for a `{placeholder}` renders as a missing parameter**: the literal `{name}` by default, with a development warning that says the parameter is a function, or an empty string under `missingParam: "drop"`. 0.5.0 printed the function's source code. This is what a message hits when it says `{link}` where it needs `<link>…</link>`. Tag handlers and every other parameter value are unchanged.

## Chrome extension 0.5.1

- **The extension no longer bundles the editor.** It asks the site's `devtools()` loader for it, so the site needs `@comvi/core` 0.5.1 or newer with `.use(devtools())` on the i18n instance.
- **A site on 0.5.0** gets "Comvi i18n v0.5.0 found, but it cannot load the editor" in the popup. Upgrade the site's `@comvi/*` packages to 0.5.1 and reload.
- **The 0.5.0 extension keeps working with a 0.5.1 site**: it activates the editor it bundles.
- **When the editor cannot start, the popup names the reason and the remedy**: no `devtools()` on the page, an SDK older than 0.5.1, a Content Security Policy that blocks `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, a failed or slow download.
- The extension requests no new permission.

## Fixes

- **In-context editor**: translation text no longer shifts to the right when you start editing a field. The "Languages" picker shows all of its languages instead of letting the first translation field draw over them. The source language is listed first with a neutral `Source` marker instead of an orange tint.
- **In-context editor on a strict `style-src`**: the editor renders on a site whose policy allows neither inline styles nor a nonce.
- **In-context editor, standalone build**: `ComviInContextEditor.version` is the package version, and `getStatus().hook` reports the `devtools()` loader that started it.
- **`@comvi/core`**: in development, the "parameter is a function" warning and the "missing parameter" warning no longer silence each other for the same message and placeholder.
- **`@comvi/nuxt`**: the build-time check of `localeDetection.resolveAcceptLanguage` uses `vm.Script`, so the module no longer contains `new Function`. The source is parsed and never executed.
- **`@comvi/next` docs**: the `<I18nProvider>` JSDoc example names the hand-written `"use client"` wrapper `ClientProvider`. `<ComviProvider>` means the export from `@comvi/next/server`, which makes that wrapper unnecessary under `withComvi`.

## Requirements

- Unchanged from 0.5.0. Install the same version of every `@comvi/*` package.

Documentation: <https://comvi.io/docs/i18n>
